about: Candidate causes shared by every golden case. Each lists its sources, what an image of dots would show if it were acting (only where a source says so), and the matching cause id(s) in web/packs/nsw/index.ts.

sources.matc82: docs/personal/matc82.pdf -- NPL Report MATC(A)82, A Guide to Best Practice for Electronic Materials Dispensing (2001). Page numbers are the printed page numbers, which match the PDF page index.
sources.brief: docs/NSW Automation .pdf -- AI Dispensing Defect Detective, NSW Automation challenge brief. Pages are PDF page index (the brief has no printed numbers).

causes.label: Dispensed volume too small to wet the pad (big dot / small dot)
causes.image_signature: A very small or missing dot, followed by a larger over-sized dot at the next deposition point in dispense order.
causes.mapping_note: No equivalent cause in the current pack.

causes.label: Pressure-time dispensing variability (pressure or dispense time not stable)
causes.image_signature_note: Sources describe variable volumes and, for solder paste and ICA, missed dots -- but no pattern across positions or dispense order.
causes.mapping_note: Partial match: the pack's parameter_drift rules model a mis-set parameter (recent adjustment, error in one direction), not the shot-to-shot variability matc82 attributes to pressure-time systems.

causes.label: Air trapped in the syringe or material supply
causes.image_signature_note: The brief links air to volume that changes occasionally rather than continuously -- a pattern over time, not within one image. matc82 mentions air entrapment only for underfills (sec 7.2 p.38) and glob tops (sec 6.5 p.37), never for dot dispensing.

causes.label: Material viscosity or condition change
causes.image_signature_note: Sources describe volume changing over time (curing, ambient temperature, settling in the syringe, heating from repeated pressurising), not a pattern within one array.
causes.mapping_note: The pack splits this into two causes.

causes.label: Partial nozzle or needle blockage
causes.image_signature_note: No source describes how a blockage looks in an image of dots.

causes.label: Wrong dispense height, or board bent during clamping
causes.image_signature: Deposit shape changes with position on the board: squat where the needle sits low, tall where it sits high.

causes.label: Dispensing equipment needs inspection or cleaning
causes.image_signature_note: No source describes an image signature.
